539: The Princess of the Valley of Wind. She is clever, resourceful, and a skilled swordswoman. She is a windrider, who can read and utilize the wind well, and flies a "Mehve", a glider with an engine.
540: Nausicaä's teacher and legendary swordsman. He's been traveling the world in search of the secret of the Sea of Corruption.
541: Princess of Torumekia, youngest daughter of the Vai Emperor. In the anime, she lost one of her arms as a child during an Ohmu attack, and is driven by a desire for revenge against the giant insects.
542: Princess Kushana's staff officer. In the manga, he was sent by Kushana's father, the Vai Emperor, to spy on her and to steal the God Warrior's control stone. Once Kushana uncovered this plot, Kurotowa immediately offered to switch allegiances and work for her in earnest.
543: Rastel's twin brother. He is the sole survivor of Pejite, and deeply hates Kushana and Torumekians. He is a very good pilot, mechanic, and swordsman.
544: Asbel's twin sister, who is the princess of Pejite and died when the airship she is in crashes near the Valley of the Wind.
8777: A giant insect species who guards the Sea of Corruption. They live in larger groups and are easily provoked if one of their own kind gets injured.
9091: The furry and lovable fox-squirrel companion of Nausicaa. Found accidentally by Lord Yupa, but seemed to grow towards Nausicaa easily. Resides on Nausicaa's shoulder or amongst her cleavage.
11248: King of the Valley of the Wind and Nausicaa's father.
